Valley Spokesmen Friendly Friday

San Ramon, CA · Road

Valley Spokesmen Friendly Friday is a road group ride in San Ramon, CA. It rolls every Friday at 9:00 am from Sports Basement San Ramon.

For visitors

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 9:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: 3L/M, no-drop. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Valley Spokesmen Friendly Friday group ride

A friendly Friday morning ride of 30 to 40 miles from Sports Basement in San Ramon, with coffee at Lakeside Coffee. Rated 3L/M and no-drop. Register on the event page first. Non-members are welcome.
